provider.surfaces: Existing credited native ArrayRef/StructArray, immutable PreparedMemoryProjection, native checked scalar Expression, native Sort/Batch/Table and native spill. SharedArray is a one-way OnceLock cache, not a revocable owner; ScalarFnArray alone does not preserve the caller's eager error order and certificate/grant contract.

candidate.shape: Bound root Sort(Project(ScanSource::Memory)); no scan filter/residual, dynamic/parameterized root, file/batch source, nested parent or explicit spill policy.
candidate.grammar: All projected dtypes are nullable/nonnullable Int64. Direct outputs are same-name columns. Derived roots are Binary Add/Subtract/Multiply over Int64 columns/literals with at most two binary levels and at least one column. No literal-only output, renamed alias, non-Int64 output or derived sort key.
candidate.dependency: Union of every referenced input column, including direct outputs/keys, in original input schema order. Borrow bound expressions; retain the immutable original source. Charge cloned recipe/schema/key metadata before allocation. No replay, cross-operation state, extra grant or external owner revocation.
candidate.validation: Evaluate the complete original projection in original expression/input order before dropping its private result. Retain dependency projection in ordinary Sort. Preserve eager checked errors before any sorted delivery. Observe actual shared-pool live bytes before evaluation, while projected output is live, and after final private drop.
candidate.headroom_contract: Checked conservative planning allowance held during retention, released immediately before existing Sort finalization. Real gather/rebuild allocations continue through the original allocator; denial propagates. Report allowance, live transitions and lifetime peak separately; no scoped-peak or RSS claim.
candidate.regeneration: Existing stable ordinal sort gathers only dependency fields. Evaluate original projection once per ordered native batch, then synchronously consume. Regenerated row count cannot exceed fully validated rows; no recursion/retry. Check cancellation at transitions. Drop all private owners on failure.

workload.fixture: Source fields k(nullable I64), ordinal(nonnullable I64), x(nullable I64), y(nullable I64), then optional extras. For original row r: k=NULL if r%31==0 else (r*17%257)-128; ordinal=r; x=NULL if r%11==0 or all_null profile else (r*13%100003)-50001; y=NULL if r%17==0 else (r*7%10007)-5003. Boolean profile adds nonnullable flag=(r%3==0). wide_unused adds 64 nonnullable I64 u000..u063, u_j=r*3+j. wide_dependencies adds 64 nullable I64 x000..x063, each with x nullness and value x+j*5. All arithmetic fits I64 in ordinary fixtures.
workload.projection: Output k and ordinal, then d000..d(width-1). Ordinary d_j=x*(j+1)+y; wide_dependencies uses x_j instead of x. NULL propagates. aliases d_j=x with renamed output; constants d_j=I64 literal j+1. Boolean profile appends flag. Other profiles use ordinary arithmetic. Output order and declared dtype/nullability are exact.
workload.sort: k ASC NULLS LAST; derived_key profile instead uses d000 ASC NULLS LAST. No ordinal tie key is added: stable ties must preserve the original row order, independently witnessed by ordinal.
workload.binary: One freshly compiled source-bound release test executable. Identical common fixture/oracle/consumer/observer. Test-only switch disables the complete candidate before admission for retain/spill; regenerate uses ordinary candidate admission. Production has no switch/observer. No stale cached binary may substitute for source equality.
workload.consumer: One public PreparedVortexRelational::for_each_batch call. Every bounded native batch is fully consumed into an explicit caller-owned binary witness, with exact dtype and all values. Native payload/temporary allocations use the original pool; test fixture/witness bytes are outside it and cannot support an RSS bound. No complete JSON collector or partial result.
workload.binary_witness: Ordered row-major values: for every scalar, one byte 0 for NULL or 1 for a value, followed by exactly eight little-endian bytes, zero for NULL, signed i64 for integers, 0/1 for Boolean. Schema separately retains exact field order/type/nullability. Source uses the same format. Every source and output byte is retained and SHA-256 addressed; independent Python reconstructs formulas and sorted full output. Raw witness creation/hashing/validation is outside compared clocks except the synchronous consumption/copy itself, which is included in the complete workflow.
workload.preflight: All 13 cells at declared rows plus each cell overridden to 0 and 17 rows, once per role: 117 complete workflows. Preserve nominal cell identity and actual rows. Require complete independent output/resource/activation/source checks before timing. Debug smoke runs all zero/17-row cells plus mixed-32768-8 in each role; release performs all 117. Failed attempts remain immutable and are never counted complete.
workload.order: A: retain, spill, regenerate; B: regenerate, spill, retain with reversed cell order. Each role/cohort is a fresh guarded native process. Within a cell use samples 0,1,2. Both cohorts complete before comparative analysis.
workload.warmup: One mixed-32768-8 complete workflow per role/cohort, retained but excluded from decisions.
workload.activation: Regenerate activates exactly for declared-row mixed targets, wide_unused, wide_dependencies and all_null; all other profiles/row overrides and both retain/spill roles do not activate. Active paths validate and regenerate exactly the original row count, evaluate projection twice per row, retain the entire declared dependency union, and never read/reprepare the source again. Inactive paths evaluate once per row. Every target's actual private release must be at least rows*derived*8 bytes summed across input batches. Alias/key/constant controls have no candidate reclamation. Spill writes actual runs in all four targets; every role completes exactly one execution from one resident construction, one prepared source, zero files/opens, then zero reservations and empty owned spill directory. Ordinary workflows have no denied reservation.

decision.primary_clock: engine_execution_ns from complete public-call elapsed minus measured synchronous native consumer duration, using the existing QueryTiming contract. Keep consumption separate; never substitute process time.
decision.complete_clock: Sum of session/source/plan/preparation, complete execution plus synchronous consumption, result release and final prepared/source/session destruction. Fixture generation, independent oracle/verification and witness file I/O are outside all roles symmetrically.
decision.memory_targets: Each of the four targets in EACH cohort: median complete native pool peak improves versus retain by at least 20% AND 131072 bytes. Include pinned original sources, keys, recipe, headroom, real rebuild and consumer scratch. No snapshot reset or unmeasured process-memory claim.
decision.controls: For every cell in EACH cohort, reject if regenerate median engine OR complete workflow time increases versus retain by BOTH more than 5% and more than 1000000 ns. No cell may increase median peak native reservations by more than 65536 bytes.
decision.spill_comparison: For all four targets in EACH cohort, spill must write real runs and regenerate must avoid engine OR complete workflow regression versus spill exceeding BOTH 5% and 1000000 ns. Record all three roles' actual memory/disk/cost results. A refusal is never a timing win.
decision.retain: All semantic/source/activation/resource/lifecycle/preflight and frozen memory/throughput gates are mandatory. Then full focused/native/CLI/workspace/installed Python/Public39/one Full43/modular acceptance and independent evidence reopening on exact final sources precede production retention.
decision.reject: Any failed valid frozen gate rejects this finite mechanism; preserve all observations and remove candidate/hooks with exact accepted-source restoration. Repair demonstrated harness/implementation defects without relaxing scope/gates and retain failed attempts. No post-result threshold/shape tuning, extra cohort or selected subset. Broader owner remains open.

focused_contracts: Admission boundaries 32767/32768/65536/65537, derived widths 7/8/64/65, grammar depth/operators/types, direct names/keys and forbidden file/batch/dynamic/parameterized/nested plans.
Mixed/all-null/empty/one-row results, exact dtypes, stable ties and full wide dependency closure; late checked overflow fails before any sorted delivery in ordinary and candidate paths.

Original pool owns source, keys, metadata/headroom and rebuilt payload; recipe/headroom and later allocation denial fail deterministically with final owner release. Denied attempts are not comparison samples.
Pre-cancellation, cancellation at reconstruction, failing first/later consumer and successful subsequent fresh operation; no completed certificate on failure.
Private projected buffer release is observed after its final owner. Escaped completed native output clones/slices remain valid and credited until final drop; no external result revocation.
